easyPrerequisites: Lands you control can tap to produce at least {4}{B}{R}
description:
Activate any number of lands by tapping them, adding at least {4}{B}{R}.
Activate Kenrith's first ability by paying {R}, giving all creatures trample and haste until end of turn.
Activate Llanowar Druid by tapping and sacrificing it, untapping all lands you control, as they are all Forests due to Yavimaya.
Activate Kenrith's fifth ability by paying {4}{B}, returning Llanowar Druid from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.
